The '''''Wanderer''-class transport''' was a catch-all ship designation that was used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and applied to military vessels that had been converted to civilian use during both the [[Great Galactic War]] and [[Galactic War]], as well as the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between them. Most ''Wanderer''-class transports were stripped-down [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvettes]]. The ''[[Daybreaker]]'', a transport under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dal (Cathar)|Dal]] in [[3643 BBY]], served as a Navy [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]], and the [[Esseles (starship)|''Esseles'']] was a civilian transport that was [[Assault on the Esseles|attacked]] by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Rycus Kilran]] in an attempt to capture the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] ambassador [[Vyn Asara]].
